score_basis: Default resolver validates hash/type and broad core, cycle detection, per-call sharing, max-depth and atomic staged cache cases pass. But requested public custom get_ref path returns offsetNone and bypasses all external hashing, including resolved delta output. Concrete wrong bytes are published into cache and public get_raw serves them under the requested OID in both SHA1/SHA256. Core is usable but explicitly requested trust boundary remains incomplete. Repeated hash cases are one root cause, not independent severity penalties.
